notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.22.10
New debayer method: AHD. Internal testing shows, in general, the best performing is RCD>Edge>AHD>VNG>BiLinear
Update to ABE to make it easier to draw exclusion areas at the corners or edges. Updated simple poly sample point creation to be much more robust and to be exclusion zone aware.
Stacking Suite updates to preserve and create WCS data much more robustly
Updated crop to adjust the WCS even on data with ill formed header data.
Numba threadsafe warmup and bootstrap improvement.
Fixed issue where --new-instance argument did not create a new instance.
